Extended existing Human intent, approval, dispatch, preflight, and admission owners for one bound batch and one Executor invocation on the lawful cumulative base.
Batch package gates require a real authorized committed delta and one exact successful verification episode bound to the RUN and result candidate.
Added independent per-finding DELTA outcomes, explicit batch transport discrimination, and frontier reduction that retains unresolved, blocked, unrelated, and newly discovered findings.
Publisher authenticates batch lineage, re-derives the complete frontier, requires closure, and rechecks correction refs before publication.

Added focused synthetic tests covering batch success, partial outcomes, cumulative follow-up, invalid selectors, substituted artifacts, forged evidence, conflicting correction, publication blocking, and legacy single-finding behavior.
Added versioned documentation covering exact Human selection, execution, review, partial resolution, explicit recovery limits, publication gates, and unknown performance savings.
Committed changes are confined to the 24 permitted paths; Kernel and roadmap files remain unchanged.
